emotional_tone: Commanding, professional, high-end, alive, responsive. A digital executive suite meets a tactical locker room.

rules: Headings (Bebas Neue): MUST be uppercase with tracking-wide (letter-spacing: 0.05em) to enforce the Coach personality.
Body (DM Sans): Use leading-relaxed (1.6) for chat legibility to prevent fatigue.
CRITICAL: Do not use default sans or Inter.

layout_and_spacing.global_structure: CSS Grid or Tailwind Grid. lg:grid-cols-[1fr_400px]. Left side is Chat, Right side is Sidebar Panel.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous internal padding (p-6 to p-8) for surfaces to avoid claustrophobia.
layout_and_spacing.iframe_considerations: Height locked to 100vh. Body gets overflow-hidden. Left and right panes get overflow-y-auto to scroll independently. Hide default scrollbars for a premium feel (::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 0px; }).

surfaces_and_textures.background: Simulate depth with a CSS radial gradient on the body: radial-gradient(circle at 0% 0%, #0A101D 0%, #04070D 100%). No flat backgrounds.
surfaces_and_textures.glassmorphism_panels: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A101D]/70 with a 1px solid border of white/10 (or border-[#F0A500]/20 for active states) to create the 'crystal' effect.
surfaces_and_textures.card_hover: Interactive cards lift (-translate-y-0.5) and cast a subtle gold ambient shadow (shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(240,165,0,0.15)]).

header.style: Glassmorphism sticky header. Z-index 50. CoachG logo text in Bebas Neue.
header.ai_status_indicator: Small circular dot (bg-[#F0A500]) with Tailwind's 'animate-ping' (or custom CSS keyframes) on an absolute pseudo-element to simulate a heartbeat/online pulse.

chat_area.user_bubble: Sleek, subtle gold gradient (bg-gradient-to-br from-[#D99500] to-[#B37A00]), text-white, border-none, rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm.
chat_area.ai_bubble: Matte dark navy (bg-[#121A2F]), white text, bold left accent (border-l-2 border-[#F0A500]), rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm.
chat_area.quick_actions: Pill-shaped tags. bg-transparent border border-[#F0A500]/30 text-[#F0A500]. Hover: bg-[#F0A500]/10 border-[#F0A500].
chat_area.chat_input: Floating dock. Glassmorphism bg. Input area has focus-within:ring-1 focus-within:ring-[#F0A500] focus-within:bg-[#121A2F]. Includes paperclip icon for screenshots.
chat_area.typing_indicator: Three small dots pulsing sequentially in gold.

sidebar.tabs: Tab list container with a bottom border (border-white/10). Active tab: text-[#F0A500] border-b-2 border-[#F0A500]. Inactive tab: text-[#8B9BB4].
sidebar.form_inputs: Pure HTML forms. Inputs have bg-[#04070D] (darker than surface), border border-white/10. Focus state: border-[#F0A500] shadow-[0_0_0_2px_rgba(240,165,0,0.2)]. No native blue outline.
sidebar.ticket_success: State showing green/gold checkmark, fading in, displaying Ticket ID.

motion_and_interaction.transitions: All hover and focus states must have 'transition-all duration-300 ease-out'.
motion_and_interaction.form_validation: Use vanilla JS to handle form state. Errors show as subtle red/gold toast notifications floating at top right or inline below inputs.

testing_attributes.requirement: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement this strictly as a SINGLE HTML FILE. Use Tailwind CSS via CDN. Do not use React or external JS frameworks. Write all state logic (tabs, chat DOM injection, form localStorage saving, Webhook fetch) in a <script> tag at the bottom of the body. Implement a sleek, custom scrollbar using vanilla CSS. Embed Lucide icons using the CDN script or raw inline SVGs.
